response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS mean_diff FROM patient_averages) SELECT pa.SEX, AVG(pa.avg_pt) AS avg_patient_pt, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_patient_iga_igm_diff, AVG(pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / NULLIF(om.mean_diff, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM patient_averages AS pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE pa.SEX <> '' GROUP BY pa.SEX;

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean includes patients with blank or NULL sex because it is computed across all patients with matching laboratory records before the sex breakdown.
